data.body:
[P2] Do not checkpoint or wrap nondeterminism from nested operations

When an operation inside `run_in_child_context` hits the new validator, its error escapes through the child function. `ChildOperationExecutor.execute` then catches it, writes a child `FAIL` checkpoint, and raises `ChildContextError`, losing the `NON_DETERMINISTIC_EXECUTION` termination reason and mutating history after drift was detected. Re-raise `NonDeterministicExecutionError` (or all `ExecutionError`s) before child failure handling and add a nested-child test.
